title: Krypt
tagline: Because Crypto has an ever-increasing value, creating savings bonds for children or loved ones will be important. As well as helping you hodl during the hard times.
description: This project allows people to lock up their funds in a secure auto-generated smart contract for a set amount of time. Moreover, it presents the private key to the owner once the time is up, allowing for children to get access to capital once they are of age. Alternatively, this can be used as a mechanism to help users hodl their coins from their own hands, as it can be tough to hodl during the dips.
how_its_made: This project uses react and solidity in order to build the backend. More specifically we used Vite to help host the frontend and deployed the smart contract on the Mumbai Testnet for the Polygon Network. Furthermore, we used WalletConnect for wallet connection and Tatum for deploying on multiple networks.
